description: A three-octave keyboard strip highlighting the key nearest a chosen frequency, with note name, octave, exact frequency, and cents error.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
Music Technology
Peak Detection
